the rising of desire, excess of love or passion (cf. शृङ्गार), Sāh.
a partic. military array in the form of a horn or crescent, MBh. vi, 2413
a syringe, water-engine, Ragh.; Śiś.
the female breast, BhP.
a lotus, L.
Agallochum, L.
